title: Purchased 2. One was great, the other not.
text:
Purchased 2. One was great, the other not.. This items sticks with a square sticky pad that has a plastic hook type of thing to hold the metal soap basket. On one of the soap dishes, the hook was perfect and easy to slide the soap dish into. On the other soap dish, the plastic part wasn't wide enough and the soap dish wouldn't snap into place. I tried wiggling it into place and it snapped the hook. It comes with 2 hooks and the other was the same. I believe that one was defective.

If they send me 2 more hooks without me having to return this one, I will adjust the feedback because the one that fit properly is great!
